//Entra: Redirect sign-in for the hosted website. Leave ClientId/TenantId/ClientSecret empty and no
authentication is added at all, which is what the offline executable needs.
Register an application in Entra, add a Web redirect URI of <your site>/signin-oidc, and
grant it the delegated Azure Service Management permission user_impersonation.
Put ClientSecret in user secrets, an environment variable or Key Vault - not in this file.
Cloud is Public, UsGovernment, China or Custom and must match the tenant.
